query: How do I design a custom sketchbook cover?

goal.title: Make a gold paper bookmark with floral decoration
goal.description: Flatten a strip of gold paper over a notebook and fold its ends to size it. Cut away the excess with scissors, fold both long edges inward and crease the strip flat. Sketch a flower and curved stem in pencil, then trace them with a blue marker. Peel several small floral stickers from their clear backing and press them along the stem. Lay the decorated strip on the notebook, cover it with overlapping pieces of wide transparent tape and smooth the surface. Trim excess tape around the strip with scissors, lift the finished bookmark and set it down.
goal.final_state: A narrow gold bookmark with a blue flower outline and small floral stickers lies on the notebook beneath a shiny transparent covering.
procedure: Size and cut a rectangular gold paper strip.
Fold its long edges inward and flatten the bookmark blank.
Sketch and trace a flower and stem.
Peel and attach small floral stickers.
Cover the decorated strip with transparent tape.
Trim the excess tape and set down the finished bookmark.

phases.description: Flatten the gold strip over the notebook, fold its short ends to mark the length, cut away both excess ends and move the scraps aside.
Turn the paper strip over, fold both long edges inward and pinch and smooth its ends and creases.
Sketch the floral shape with pencil, then trace a blue flower outline and long curved stem with the marker before recapping it.
Pick up a clear-backed sticker sheet and repeatedly peel small flower clusters, press them onto the gold strip and smooth their edges.
Position the strip on the notebook, pull lengths of wide transparent tape, cut them and press overlapping strips over the decorated paper.
Rotate and lift the work over the notebook, cut projecting tape around its edges and set the finished bookmark down.
